calculation.description: Ranks an asset higher when its intraday return is negative, trading volume is elevated relative to its 20-session median, and the candle body is small relative to its daily range. Uses only the completed session and is intended as a one-day reversal signal.

validation.regime_notes: Across the 15 tradable benchmark instruments, 1,680 valid daily cross-sectional IC observations used an average 8.93 instruments per date (minimum 8). Daily IC was positive across 2020-2022 (0.097409; 690 dates), 2023-2024 (0.075191; 459 dates), and 2025-2027 (0.026865; 531 dates), with deterioration in the latest regime. Five-day IC remained positive at 0.041349 and ten-day IC at 0.015327. Small-universe uncertainty and selective volume/range coverage require conservative ensemble sizing and correlation review.
